'''Vurrha Jantsk''' was a [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as the leader of the [[Jantsk mercenaries]], a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] group based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Endor/Legends|Endor]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The Emperor sent you? I understand his wishes. But first you need to retrieve a datadisk from a Rebel base on Dantooine. Return after you have it and after it has been altered by an Imperial operative in Kaadara.|Vurrha Jantsk, to an Imperial spacer|<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" />}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] sent an unidentified Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] to work with Jantsk in a plot to discredit the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] in the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the [[Monarch of Naboo/Legends|monarch]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Kylantha]]. The Queen had proven her loyalty many times over to Palpatine, but he eventually came to suspect that her sympathies actually lay with the Rebellion.<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" />

Jantsk and his men's mission was to go to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] and attack Queen Kylantha's chambers. Thanks to a falsified [[Datacard/Legends|datadisk]], the attack would then be attributed to the Rebels. On the Emperor's instructions, it was imperative that none of Jantsk's men knew that the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] was hiring them. When his usefulness came to an end, Jantsk was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in his [[Mercenary Bunker|base]] by the Imperial spacer on Palpatine's orders. This way, any connection to the Empire disappeared with Jantsk.<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vurrha Jantsk was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vurrha Jantsk was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Imperial Theme Park|Imperial Theme Park]],"<ref name="SWG:TEatQ" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Update Notes 6.12: September 13 2007|Chapter 6.12]]" update, on [[September 13]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67417&month=092007|text=Chapter 6.12: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
